speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have heard no walking for a fortnight. What have you done up there, if you are not walking it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is finished. I will tell you the whole, since you have asked, and since it is finished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A king who thinks the name is the thing. A cousin wronged, who comes back for his own and takes everything.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am hearing it. The knife is down. Go on.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A crown handed across. A prison. A coffin.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the cousin reigns?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He reigns.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Prosperously?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Uneasily.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is not punishment, that is indigestion. I call it a bad example, and I'd not show it this month of all months.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not showing it. The fellows have not heard it. It is not out of this house.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Who speaks for the king at the end?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A groom. And the man who had him killed.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A groom. Then the last word is not a lord's. I have heard you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Why did he break the glass?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It told him the truth.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then it was a good glass, and he should've kept it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me, the girl has the right end of it. A glass that tells the truth is not the thing you break in a bad month.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He breaks it. That is what he does. I am not mending the man to please the table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I did not ask you to mend him. I asked what the walking had been, and you have told me, and I have called it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A name, and then a coffin. The house has it now. I will not tell it on the stair.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not tell it either. The glass should have been kept. That is my part of it, and I am done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it stays in the house. Not in the yard. Not in a man's ear who has not been sat at this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A fortnight of quiet feet, and this at the end of it. Eat. The knife can go back to the loaf, which is still a penny, whatever your king has done to a glass.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The loaf is the loaf. The king is told, in this room, and nowhere else tonight.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Nowhere else. I am across the stair, and the stair is not the street.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And I am for the dishes. A good glass. I have said it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have all said it. I would not show it this month. That is the verdict, and the verdict does not need a second telling.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One telling. I agree with you that far, Mistress. Good night to the verdict.
